escena: SCENE: a still from a modern, cinematic corporate comedy sketch, photorealistic. In the same brand-new contemporary meeting room on a high floor of a modern office tower in Santiago de Chile: floor-to-ceiling frameless glass walls, a long pale oak meeting table with a thin matte black steel base, modern upholstered chairs in warm grey, a large frameless wall display, linear recessed LED ceiling lights, polished concrete floor, one sculptural green plant; through the glass the Santiago skyline and the Andes. Current-generation hardware only (thin aluminum laptops, frameless screens), clean surfaces; nothing dated, no paper stacks, no books, no old monitors, nothing worn, aftermath, screens glowing behind him out of focus. Medium close-up, 85mm f/2.8: Antonio, dry and impeccable, answers with total deadpan calm, the faintest closed-mouth smile, head almost frontal, eyes toward someone off-frame to the left. Antonio wears the Efeonce corporate uniform: the deep navy bomber jacket of the kit, CLOSED, with its embroidered emblem on the left chest exactly as in the references, over a plain white t-shirt. Light: the whole room is now flooded with vivid, saturated orange and teal light pouring from the screens, warm sunlight breaking through the windows, punchy contrast, high energy.
